description: Source code for the ElasticSearchCommands class, a CLI command class for integrating Elasticsearch operations within SuiteCRM, including search, index, and delete index functionalities.

classes.name: ElasticSearchCommands
classes.description: A command class providing Elasticsearch-related CLI commands for search, index, and delete index operations within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: elasticSearch
methods.description: Performs a search using Elasticsearch with specified query, size, and JSON output options.

methods.name: elasticIndex
methods.description: Indexes the database into Elasticsearch, supporting full or differential indexing, with options for different documentifiers.

methods.name: printModuleResults
methods.description: Outputs search results for each module, either as JSON or plain text.

methods.name: showSearchTime
methods.description: Displays the time taken for the search operation.
